source.title: IRS MeF ATS Test Scenario 12, TY2026 Form 1040 (Sam Gardenia: 1040, Sch. 1, 2, 3, C, SE, Form 3800 + Sch. A, 4562-B, 7205, 7207, 7220, W-2)
source.edition: TREASURY/IRS DRAFT Version A (forms created 2026-03 to 2026-06)

neutral_facts.reason: the ATS prints whole dollars (1,535); the exact 1.45% of box 5 (105,878) is 1,535.23 and the App refuses Medicare withholding below it (triage F-1)
the scenario gives no birth date; any age 19-64 changes nothing here

known_gaps.note: A Form 7205 designer deduction leaves the business out of the estimate (WARN_BUSINESS_LEFT_OUT); scenario-12-7205 asserts it (D-1)

expected_note: The same facts as scenario-12 with the Form 7205 designer deduction declared as a special treatment: the App leaves the business out, so Schedule 1 line 3, Schedule 2 line 4 and everything after them differ from the source (D-1, ledger SCHC-G6).
